mapper.select: SELECT ddpvuc.id, t.dates, t.pkg, t.`user_type`, t.user_source, t.user_num FROM (select duc.dates, duc.pkg, 0 `user_type`, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown') user_source, count(DISTINCT duc.user_id) user_num from dwd_user_conversion duc left join dim_user_source dus on (dus.user_id = duc.user_id) where duc.dates = #{dates} group by duc.dates, duc.pkg, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown')) t left join dws_daily_pkg_usrc_conversion ddpvuc on (t.dates = ddpvuc.dates and t.pkg = ddpvuc.pkg and t.user_type = ddpvuc.user_type and t.user_source = ddpvuc.user_source)

SELECT ddpvuc.id, t.dates, t.pkg, t.`user_type`, t.user_source, t.user_num FROM (select duc.dates, duc.pkg, 1 `user_type`, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown') user_source, count(DISTINCT duc.user_id) user_num from dwd_user_conversion duc left join dim_user_source dus on (dus.user_id = duc.user_id) where duc.dates = #{dates} and duc.dates = duc.register_dates group by duc.dates, duc.pkg, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Unknown')) t left join dws_daily_pkg_usrc_conversion ddpvuc on (t.dates = ddpvuc.dates and t.pkg = ddpvuc.pkg and t.user_type = ddpvuc.user_type and t.user_source = ddpvuc.user_source)
